limitations: Historical data is already inspected and cannot serve as pristine confirmatory evidence.
Native families are deliberately few but were motivated by known market structure; Forward evidence remains required.
Selection score only orders families that already pass hard gates; it cannot rescue a failed family.
Yearly Action Days are reconstructed from executed daily position changes and are used only as an operational-cap diagnostic.
No ticker-specific fine tuning, optimization grid, inverse ETF, hierarchical switching or automatic promotion is allowed in Phase 3.
